senses.gloss:
इषित p. p. (fr. इष् {4} cl.).
1
[]
Moved, driven, sent, despatched.
--2 Excited, animated.
--3 Quick,
speedy.

ईशिता, --त्वं Superiority, greatness,
one of the eight Siddhis or
attributes of Śiva. See अणिमन्.

इषिर a. Ved. [इष्-गतौ-किरच्]
1
Juicy, succulent, refreshing, fresh.
--2 Powerful, strong, quick, active.
--3 Moving.
--रः Fire.
--रं ind.
Quickly.

इषि(षी)का [इष् गत्यादौ क्वुन् अत
इत्वं]
1 Reed, rush, stalk of grass;
कुशकाशशरेषिकाः Rām.; ˚अस्त्रं
R. 12. 23.
--2 An arrow.
--3 A sort of
sugar-cane; Saccharum Spontaneum.
--4 A small stick of wood or iron
used to see whether gold in a
crucible is melted or not.
--5 A
brush.
--6 The eye ball of an
elephant.
--Comp.
--तूलं the point or
upper part of a reed.

ईशितृ a. [ईश्-तृच्] An owner, a
master, proprietor. --m. The
[]
lord of the Universe; Śi. 18. 3.
